# errors

## Classes

### AppError

The SDK's one typed failure. Carries a closed `code` naming the failure kind and
an explicit `retryable` verdict, instead of leaving callers to guess either from
the message or exception shape.

### ErrorCopy

```ts
type ErrorCopy = Readonly<{
  title: string;
  message: string;
}>;
```

Trusted presentation copy; overrides never change recovery or retry policy.

---

### ErrorDescription

```ts
type ErrorDescription = ErrorCopy &
  Readonly<{
    retryable: boolean;
    action?: "grant" | "retry" | "reconnect" | "billing";
  }>;
```

Recovery hints are for the caller's UI, never an instruction to retry
automatically.

### mediaProviderDiagnosticWireSchema

```ts
const mediaProviderDiagnosticWireSchema: ZodPipe<
  ZodType<unknown, unknown, $ZodTypeInternals<unknown, unknown>>,
  ZodTransform<
    | Readonly<{
        category:
          | "InferenceUpstreamError"
          | "AiInternalError"
          | "TypeError"
          | "AbortError"
          | "TimeoutError"
          | "Error";
        code: number | null;
      }>
    | Readonly<{
        category: "result_download";
        status: number;
      }>,
    unknown
  >
>;
```

Documentable wire projection of the canonical diagnostic grammar. Maintained
converters preserve its closed objects and numeric bounds; decoding still
returns the declaration-safe public diagnostic type.

### appErrorCodes

```ts
const appErrorCodes: readonly [
  "CANCELLED",
  "CAPABILITY_DENIED",
  "CAPABILITY_REVOKED",
  "COMMAND_NOT_DECLARED",
  "CONFLICT",
  "DELIVERY_PENDING",
  "DISCONNECTED",
  "FILE_TOO_LARGE",
  "HOST_FAILURE",
  "IDENTITY",
  "INSUFFICIENT_CREDIT",
  "INVALID_ARGUMENT",
  "PROTOCOL",
  "SAFETY_FILTER_REFUSED",
  "SELECTION_CHANGED",
  "TIMEOUT",
];
```

The closed set of reasons an AppError can state; every SDK and host-reported
failure is tagged with exactly one of these codes.

### describeAppError()

```ts
function describeAppError(cause, overrides?): ErrorDescription;
```

Describe an SDK-decoded failure without exposing exception or request data. The
error owner retains retry truth. Grant and reconnect hints describe
prerequisites, so they can accompany a non-retryable operation.

#### Parameters

| Parameter    | Type                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| ------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `cause`      | `unknown`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `overrides?` | `Partial`\<`Record`\< \| `"CANCELLED"` \| `"CAPABILITY_DENIED"` \| `"CAPABILITY_REVOKED"` \| `"COMMAND_NOT_DECLARED"` \| `"CONFLICT"` \| `"DELIVERY_PENDING"` \| `"DISCONNECTED"` \| `"FILE_TOO_LARGE"` \| `"HOST_FAILURE"` \| `"IDENTITY"` \| `"INSUFFICIENT_CREDIT"` \| `"INVALID_ARGUMENT"` \| `"PROTOCOL"` \| `"SAFETY_FILTER_REFUSED"` \| `"SELECTION_CHANGED"` \| `"TIMEOUT"`, `Readonly`\<\{ `title`: `string`; `message`: `string`; \}\>\>\> |
